description: Flat 200 m x 120 m field, no wind, International Standard Atmosphere at sea level. The reference for comparing against other worlds.
name: Calm test field

air.humidity.note: 0 %: the dry-air convention of the ISA.

air.pressure.note: Blank: ISA pressure at 0 m, 1013.25 hPa.

air.temperature.note: 15 C: the ISA sea-level temperature (ICAO Doc 7488).

origin.note: Position shared with the Illinois preset; elevation set to sea level on purpose, for ISA.

surface.z0.note: Short grass 0.03 m, Davenport-Wieringa roughness classification (Wieringa 1992).

time.note: Summer solstice, 18:00 UTC; a scenario time.

wind.speed.note: Zero by definition of a calm test.
